durationRule: Round up (edit frames + 48) / 24 to available generation duration; preserve full original.
handles: Request at least one second of moving lead and tail when generating. These are optional editing room, not protected reserves: freely consume them by slipping source footage to favor action and payoff. Preserve musical cut points and lyric timing; do not move timeline cuts merely to retain handles.
performanceDirection: Specify motivation, emotional change and visible acting beats for each featured character; avoid fixed expressions and mechanical gesture lists.
cameraDirection: Choose motivated camera movement for quieter action; preserve spatial parallax and readable geography. Busy action may use a fixed camera.
referencePreflight: Verify completed upload, correct filename and visible starting-frame thumbnail before Generate.
legacyException: Belle original has 169 frames; current 141-frame edit starts at source16, leaving head16 and tail12. Retained approved performance without regeneration.
editPriority: Fixed musical placement and duration first; choose source in/out for best performance. Retained head/tail may be less than one second or zero.
